description: With a profound interest in data science and active studies in college, I engage in a wide array of organizations and events, acquiring hands-on experience across multiple domains such as UI/UX design, backend development, machine learning, statistical modeling, and computer vision. I am committed to leveraging data-driven approaches to solve real-world problems, conduct impactful research, and improve decision-making processes.

With a solid foundation in software engineering from Universitas Gadjah Mada, I specialize in frontend development, adept at crafting intuitive, responsive, and visually appealing user interfaces using React Native, Next.js, and TypeScript. My experience includes leading front-end projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and seamlessly integrating front-end components with back-end services. Alongside technical proficiency, my active involvement in committees and organizations has refined my teamwork, communication, and leadership skills.

A passionate Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in UI/UX Design, Backend and Frontend Development, and Database Management. Dedicated to leveraging technical expertise to tackle real-world challenges and develop innovative digital solutions that enhance user experiences.
